official_start: A pair registration committed and pushed after the final new pipeline freeze; before its fresh schematic request or any stimulus
selection: First started new-cohort attempt per case; preserve and count all failures and followups, never silently substitute a later success
operator_reading_selection: Spark chooses one intended component and quantity. Operator chooses a permitted source only after every source-specific forecast is frozen and pushed.
body_binding: Spark sees schematic, full clean photo and SAM-derived crops. Operator confirms yes/no. Explicit operator override is labelled chosen_by=operator, never Spark.
preserved_electrical_guards: A3 primary raw 3mV block-mean span; A4 auxiliary record/report; no k or offset correction; all other trusted guard checks unchanged
all_explanations_fail: Record all_explanations_rejected; no positive location claim or range refit. Stop/abstain or explicitly register later work.
restored_caption: No mismatch in the tests Spark chose
repair_claim: Operator restoration plus a fresh-context rerun. Do not overwrite a native diagnostic physical_repair_demonstrated:false.

prior_development.note: Old runs called official under the previous protocol keep those original registrations. They are development history relative to this materially different pipeline; they do not become nonexistent successes or failures.

scope.reading_implementation: Numeric R/C quantity and source-aware intervals. DMM resistance is enabled with explicit range/resolution/isolation; DMM capacitance disabled pending capability confirmation.
scope.future_presence_continuity: Requires a separately qualified categorical/continuity observable; a missing SAM mask is never proof of component absence.
scope.LED: Physical active path remains disabled until separate absolute-DC qualification
